trans-unit.source: Please translate the following segments carefully.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
trans-unit.target: Le rapide renard brun saute par-dessus le chien paresseux.

trans-unit.source: Translation memory helps you reuse previous translations.
Confirm a segment to save it to the translation memory.
trans-unit.target: Confirmez un segment pour l'enregistrer dans la mémoire de traduction.

trans-unit.source: Use keyboard shortcuts to navigate between segments efficiently.
Press Tab to move to the next segment.
Press Shift+Tab to move to the previous segment.
Press Ctrl+Enter to confirm the current segment.
Export your work as an XLIFF file when finished.
